guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以UV 透光、流場、劑量與驗證範圍為主線，從前處理與指標菌基線、透光率與光程、照度與時間乘積、水力通道與短流進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops uv transmission, hydraulics, fluence and validation envelope through ten connected units, beginning with pretreatment and indicator baseline, transmittance and optical path, irradiance and exposure time, hydraulic paths and short-circuiting. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
procedure: 只改變 Q:1000→1200 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1e+09 變為 1.2e+09 CFU/d。用「前處理與指標菌基線」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
只改變 T1:0.80→0.90，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.512 變為 0.729 fraction。用「透光率與光程」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
只改變 E:2→1.6 mW/cm²，其餘假設固定；結果應由 30 變為 24 mJ/cm²。用「照度與時間乘積」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「前處理與指標菌基線」的觀測點。記錄檢出限、培養法與採樣時刻，避免把未檢出當零。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「透光率與光程」的觀測點。校正光程與空白，再比較不同水樣 UVT。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「照度與時間乘積」的觀測點。對照 UVT、燈衰退、流量與經驗證反應器資料。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「水力通道與短流」的觀測點。配對流量與水位，另以示蹤或驗證資料檢查短流。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「燈老化與套管污垢」的觀測點。清潔前後讀值分開，避免把污垢歸因於燈齡。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「顆粒遮蔽與水質變動」的觀測點。校正光程與空白，再比較不同水樣 UVT。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「生物驗證與對數降低」的觀測點。列出方法回收率、重複樣本與未檢出上限。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「驗證包絡與負載」的觀測點。配對流量與水位，另以示蹤或驗證資料檢查短流。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「感測、警報與失效演練」的觀測點。清潔前後讀值分開，避免把污垢歸因於燈齡。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「採樣驗收與追溯」的觀測點。列出方法回收率、重複樣本與未檢出上限。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for pretreatment and indicator baseline. Record detection limit, culture method and sample time; do not equate nondetection to zero. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for transmittance and optical path. Calibrate path length/blank and compare UVT across samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for irradiance and exposure time. Compare UVT, lamp aging, flow and validated-reactor data. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for hydraulic paths and short-circuiting. Pair flow with water level and check short-circuiting using tracer or validation data. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for lamp aging and sleeve fouling. Separate pre/post-cleaning readings so fouling is not mistaken for lamp aging. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for particle shielding and water-quality change. Calibrate path length/blank and compare UVT across samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for biodosimetry and log reduction. Record method recovery, replicates and nondetect upper bounds. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for validation envelope and loading. Pair flow with water level and check short-circuiting using tracer or validation data. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sensing, alarms and failure rehearsal. Separate pre/post-cleaning readings so fouling is not mistaken for lamp aging. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sampling verification and traceability. Record method recovery, replicates and nondetect upper bounds. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 用單一指標菌檢測宣稱所有病原已消失。診斷與介入：確認微生物方法及檢出限，與同時段流量配對。
把 1 cm UVT 當作整座反應器的透光率。診斷與介入：確認波長、光程及空白，再查水質與顆粒變化。
以燈具銘牌功率直接當水中照度。診斷與介入：回到反應器驗證資料與流況，避免把均勻場示例作為現場劑量。
平均通過時間掩蓋最低曝光路徑。診斷與介入：用水位與示蹤查短流，核對流量是否仍在驗證範圍。
清套管後仍低輸出卻忽略老化或感測漂移。診斷與介入：分別檢查老化、污垢與感測偏差，再依程序驗證恢復。
只以濁度預測所有 UV 表現。診斷與介入：確認波長、光程及空白，再查水質與顆粒變化。
未檢出結果被直接代為零而算無限降低。診斷與介入：核對檢出限及水力配對，對未檢出結果使用可支持的下限。
日平均流量在範圍內就忽略瞬時超量。診斷與介入：用水位與示蹤查短流，核對流量是否仍在驗證範圍。
警報消音被當作水質已恢復。診斷與介入：分別檢查老化、污垢與感測偏差，再依程序驗證恢復。
不同日期或不同水團樣本直接相減。診斷與介入：核對檢出限及水力配對，對未檢出結果使用可支持的下限。
pitfallsEn: One indicator test is used to claim elimination of all pathogens. Diagnostic response: Confirm microbial method/detection limit and pair with matched-period flow.
One-centimeter UVT is treated as whole-reactor transmittance. Diagnostic response: Confirm wavelength, path length and blank, then check water/particle changes.
Lamp nameplate power is substituted for in-water irradiance. Diagnostic response: Return to reactor-validation/hydraulic data rather than using the uniform-field example as a field dose.
Mean passage time hides minimum-exposure paths. Diagnostic response: Check bypass using level/tracing and verify flow remains within the validated range.

Low output after cleaning is attributed only to residual fouling, ignoring aging or sensor drift. Diagnostic response: Check aging, fouling and sensor bias separately and verify recovery by the applicable procedure.
Turbidity alone is used to predict all UV performance. Diagnostic response: Confirm wavelength, path length and blank, then check water/particle changes.
Nondetection is entered as zero to claim infinite reduction. Diagnostic response: Check detection limits/hydraulic pairing and use supportable lower bounds for nondetection.
An acceptable daily mean hides instantaneous excursions. Diagnostic response: Check bypass using level/tracing and verify flow remains within the validated range.
Acknowledging an alarm is mistaken for restored treatment. Diagnostic response: Check aging, fouling and sensor bias separately and verify recovery by the applicable procedure.
Samples from different days or water parcels are directly compared. Diagnostic response: Check detection limits/hydraulic pairing and use supportable lower bounds for nondetection.

history.title: 污水紫外線消毒
history.text: 本課以公開技術手冊建立方法背景；來源出版年代不代表此程序首次發明的年代。舊版文件僅提供原理與歷史脈絡，現場工作仍須確認當地現行規定與設備文件。
history.textEn: Public technical manuals establish the methodological background; publication dates do not identify the invention date. Older documents provide principles and historical context, while real work still requires current local requirements and equipment documentation.

courses.connection: 本課以UV 透光、流場、劑量與驗證範圍為主線，從前處理與指標菌基線、透光率與光程、照度與時間乘積、水力通道與短流進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops uv transmission, hydraulics, fluence and validation envelope through ten connected units, beginning with pretreatment and indicator baseline, transmittance and optical path, irradiance and exposure time, hydraulic paths and short-circuiting. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
